main_text.p: urbanitatis suæ quasi fumo contra Lutheranos excitato fugiens facilius lateret. Alioqui clara luce patuisset eum horribilem sycophantam esse, qui Magdeburgenses condemnet horribilium in cœlites blasphemiarum, quòd nævos & errores Patribus attribuant.
main_text.head: CAP. V.
Calvinum horribilium in omnes cœlites blasphemiarum falsissimè à Bellarmino argui.
main_text.p: QVID de Quintino illo impuro & blasphemo Libertinorum in Gallis pa-rente dicemus, qui, ut Calvinus auctor est in institutione contra Libertinos, cap. 9. adeò petulanter in Sanctos omnes debacchabatur, ut Paulum aliter non appellaret, quàm vas confractum, Joannem iuvenem stolidulum, Matthæum fœneratorem, Petrum Christi abnegatorem?Ead.præfat. tom.I. contro-vers.7.

p.i: Porrò Calvinus, qui tam severè alios arguit impietatis, tam fuit ipse pius & religiosus, ut non contentus iis conviciis, quibus Sanctos omnes vexat, qui post Christi adventum floruerunt, etiam ad eos linguam suam flagellum extenderit, qui multis seculis eiusdem Salvatoris adventum præcesserunt. Itaque in libris Christianæ suæ institutionis, lib. 3. cap. 14. §. 11. Abrahamum idolorum cultorem facit;

page.notes: Quintino illo: the decorated initial Q is joined to "VID" as QVID; the Q was read from its shape. "Gallis pa-rente": the printed hyphen is kept, the word is "parente". The margin note "contro-vers.7." is split over a line end; the exact form of the abbreviation is read from the scan, slightly uncertain. The italic status of the paragraph beginning "Porrò" is read from the typeface and is probably correct. No catchword is printed.
